Maintain overweight on ID financials, targeting 8-12% alpha over 3 months.

themes: Indonesia's downstream nickel processing mandate continues to structurally re-rate integrated smelter operators, insulating them from ore export bans and capturing higher-margin value-add.
Global gold price strength, driven by central-bank buying and geopolitical risk, provides a durable tailwind for Indonesian gold miners with expanding reserves and production.
Energy transition policy and domestic coal-usage caps are forcing coal producers to diversify into renewables or gas, creating a long-term margin compression risk for pure-play thermal coal.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in high-grade nickel and gold names (MBMA, AMMN, BRMS) as Indonesia's downstream ban and global gold strength persist; rotate out of coal (COAL) on policy and price headwinds. ALKA/PSAB moves are speculative—take profits. Position for Q3 earnings beats in nickel smelters and gold producers.

Power utilities (NRG, CEG) are gaining defensive bid as AI-driven electricity demand forecasts tighten supply, supporting long-term contracted cash flows despite near-term volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US-listed solar/energy storage names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) and Indonesia EV/battery plays (VKTR, TOBA) on strength; sector breadth is healthy with normal signals and US leadership. Trim NRG/CEG only if utilities decouple from rate-cut expectations. Prioritize VKTR for domestic EV adoption catalysts and SEDG for US policy tailwinds into Q3.

Near-term catalyst: Q3 volume data and fuel subsidy adjustments.
